xmldoc.short_description: Determine the format of an open netCDF file.

param_input_item.param_description: Open netCDF file or group identifier.
Path of the file when used by create or open.
Numeric mode built from netCDF constants when required.

param_output_item.param_description: Return value described by the syntax shown above.

description.p: netcdf.inqFormat is a low-level wrapper around the corresponding netCDF C library operation.
Low-level functions use numeric identifiers returned by netcdf.create, netcdf.open, and related calls.
